items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Well, they had a fellow named Joe, Italian boy named Joe Cronje, or something like that.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. How long since you seen him?

Well, they had a fellow named Joe, Italian boy named Joe Cronje, or something like that. Mm-hmm. Had a saloon ready at Padilla and, Padilla and, and Sanitoba. Mm-hmm. And we, I used to meet him there. I used to meet there all the time. We could drunk together. And, uh, that's where all the boys used to meet, you know? We'd meet there. Drank all the whiskey we could and then go home and drunk. And Lewis wouldn't do that, though, would he?
